title: Orthic contract bundle
description: Canonical content-addressed artifact bundling every released Orthic contract: manifest v2, lifecycle v1, snapshot v2, their generated TS shapes, the legacy v1 schemas retained for the deprecation window, migration/deprecation metadata, and the adversarial + valid fixtures. The Hub pins this bundle; product CI pins it. Sibling-source fallback is prohibited (solimplement §3.4).
digestRule: sha256 over the canonical ordered concatenation: for each file in `files` (sorted), its relative path as UTF-8 followed by a NUL byte, then the raw file bytes (in the same order), then the constant tag `\0canonical-orthic-contract-bundle-v1`. The bundle.json file itself is excluded from its own digest. Recompute with `node schema/validate.mjs --check-bundle`.

changelog.changes: Initial released bundle. Manifest v2 replaces v1 inline-secret endpoint with a static, secret-free contract plus artifact digest. Snapshot v2 bounds items to flat capped primitives (content-free). Lifecycle v1 introduces the inherited authenticated channel. v1 schemas retained only for the deprecation window recorded in MIGRATION.md.

migration: See schema/MIGRATION.md for the v1→v2 migration rule, deprecation window, and unsupported-future refusal.
